name: Marketing Bot
author: Bragi
summary: Turns a project brief into an X launch post, a short thread, and follow-up replies designed to earn attention.
starterPrompt: Create an X launch package for this project: [project, audience, problem, proof, and link]. Draft one post, a short thread, and three natural follow-up replies.
usageNote: Review every claim, link, and tone choice before sharing. Replace generic hooks with concrete proof from the project.
